audience: academy administrators who report on courses, learners and orders in Academy of Mine

useCases.title: Review published courses and their authors
useCases.text: List the courses of the academy, then read one course with its modules and certificate templates.

useCases.title: Check enrolment and progress in a course
useCases.text: List the portals, then list the learners enrolled in one course, with their progress and registration dates.

useCases.title: Review orders from last month
useCases.text: List orders with buyer, product and status, then read one order with its items and payments.

useCases.title: Find the certificates a learner earned
useCases.text: Find a user by name or email, then list the certificates that user has earned.

useCases.title: Report on learning paths
useCases.text: List the learning paths of the academy, then read one path with its courses and details.
